title: Simulations Plus Announces Expiration of Hart-Scott-Rodino Waiting Period for Pending Acquisition by Altaris
summary: RESEARCH TRIANGLE PARK, N.C., August 13, 2026--Simulations Plus, Inc. (Nasdaq: SLP) ("Simulations Plus" or the "Company"), a global leader in model-informed and AI-accelerated drug development that advances biopharma innovation, announced the expiration of the waiting period under the Hart-Scott-Rodino Antitrust Improvements Act of 1976 in connection with the Company's previously announced acquisition by Altaris, LLC.
